aiConsent.title: Allow AI features?
aiConsent.body: RepCheck's AI features work by sending what you submit to Google's Gemini AI service, which processes it to produce your result.
aiConsent.item1: Food photos and meal notes, for calorie estimates
aiConsent.item2: Lift and challenge videos, for form scores and rep counts
aiConsent.item3: Your chat messages, plus your logged workouts for the workout chat
aiConsent.item4: Progress photos, weight and goal, for weekly check-ins and AI workout plans
aiConsent.item5: HYROX race times, for race analysis
aiConsent.fine: Only what a feature needs is sent, and only when you use it. We don't sell it or use it for advertising. You can turn this off any time in Settings → AI features.
aiConsent.declined: This feature uses AI. Turn on AI features in Settings to use it.
aiReport.thanks: Thanks — reported. We review every report within 24 hours.

hyrox.standards.detail.skierg: 1000m on the ski erg, powered entirely by your own effort — there's no weight or resistance setting to worry about.
hyrox.standards.detail.row: 1000m on the rowing machine, powered entirely by your own effort — same idea as the ski erg, just a different machine.
hyrox.standards.detail.burpeeBroadJump: Drop down, push back up, then jump forward as far as you can — repeated over and over until you've covered 80m. No equipment, just your body weight.
hyrox.standards.detail.sledPush: The loaded sled is pushed away from you for {rounds} rounds of {split} each, covering the full 50m.
hyrox.standards.detail.sledPull: The loaded sled is pulled toward you using a rope for {rounds} rounds of {split} each, covering the full 50m.
hyrox.standards.detail.farmersCarry: Carried as 2 x {weight} kettlebells, one in each hand, walking the full distance without putting them down.
hyrox.standards.detail.lunges: A {weight} sandbag carried across the shoulders for the full distance.
hyrox.standards.detail.wallBalls: A ball is squatted down and thrown up to a target {target} ft up the wall, for 100 reps total.
hyrox.standards.keyFact.machine: No added weight — just your own effort.
hyrox.standards.keyFact.sled: Fixed weight — can't be made lighter on race day.
hyrox.standards.keyFact.farmersCarry: No putting the weights down along the way.
hyrox.standards.keyFact.lunges: The sandbag stays on your shoulders the whole way.
hyrox.standards.keyFact.wallBalls: Every rep needs a full squat before the throw.
hyrox.weightAdjust.scaledSuffix: — scaled up from {standard} standard to keep total effort comparable
hyrox.weightAdjust.raceFixedWarning: ⚠ Practice mode only. On actual race day, every Pro athlete moves the standard weight shown below for the standard number of rounds — the race itself never lets you trade weight for extra rounds.
